row.evidence: Vena's security page says it supports Single Sign-On (SSO), MFA and IP restrictions, but no public Vena page documents SCIM or automated user provisioning, and its help centre is not public.
row.notes: Quote-only: two packages (Professional, Complete) with no published prices; users are licensed as Power User, Contributor or View Only. SSO is documented (including multi-tenant SSO since Summer 2024) but its plan is not stated. No SCIM documentation was found on venasolutions.com (sitemap), the developer platform (ETL import/export, hierarchy and MCP APIs only; no user-management endpoints) or Okta's OIN app (SAML only). Vena's help centre (support.venasolutions.com) is customer-only: its search API returns no articles for any query and article URLs return 403, so SCIM could be documented there. Import APIs are included; Export APIs cost extra.

limitations.text: Vena's public API reference covers ETL import jobs, export (intersections) and hierarchies only; no user, group or role endpoints are listed.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML as a supported capability (read from page markup); no provisioning actions are checked.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (vena-tutorial and vena-provisioning-tutorial return 404).

fallbacks.notes: The developer API reference is public, but Vena's help centre is customer-only (search API returns zero results for every query; article URLs return 403).
